name: dropdown-menu
title: DropdownMenu
description: Styled Solid dropdown menu backed by Keystone menu navigation, typeahead, and overlay behavior.

meta.customization: Style the generated wrappers through mason-dropdown-menu classes while Keystone owns menu roles, roving focus, typeahead, dismissal, and positioning.

parity.baseUi: Thin vertical covers Menu trigger/content positioning, item roles, roving focus, typeahead, disabled skipping, separators/groups, dismissal, and Mason styling hooks. Gaps: checkbox/radio item groups, submenu pointer grace, complex modal/non-modal layering, animation metadata, and scroll/viewport helpers remain follow-up work.
parity.kobalte: Matches Kobalte DropdownMenu/Menu direction for Solid trigger, portal content, keyboard navigation, item parts, groups, and disabled state. Gaps: richer checked item APIs, submenu intent tuning, and deeper dismissable-layer/focus restoration coverage remain follow-up work.
